Nie porównuj pakietów wyłącznie po liczb: Don't compare packages by the number of proposals alone
Większa liczba koncepcji może być wartoś: A larger number of concepts can be valuable, but on its own it doesn't determine the quality of the design. Much more important is whether the designer understands the industry, the audience, the brand's positioning and the places where the mark will be used.
Dobra oferta powinna jasno mówić, co dzi: A good proposal should clearly state what happens after the direction is chosen: how many refinement stages there are, which variants are prepared and what set of files the company receives at the end.
Równie ważne są materiały wdrożeniowe. J: Rollout materials are equally important. If after the project ends every avatar, business card, letterhead or typography rule has to be prepared separately, the cost and time of rolling out the brand grow.
Jednym z najbardziej niejasnych elementó: One of the most unclear elements of logo proposals is often the word “revisions”. For one person it means changing the color or proportions of the chosen mark; for another, creating a completely new concept. That's not the same thing.

ile kierunków kreatywnych zostanie zapre: how many creative directions will be presented,
w jaki sposób wybierany jest kierunek do: how the direction for further work is chosen,
ile rund korekt obejmuje cena,: how many rounds of corrections the price includes,

kto po stronie klienta zatwierdza projek: who approves the design on the client's side,
w którym momencie koncepcja staje się fi: at what point the concept becomes final.
Dobrze prowadzony proces nie powinien po: A well-run process shouldn't consist of randomly generating more marks until “one of them is liked”. Every direction should come from the brief and have a justification.
Jak przekazywać uwagi do projektu?: How to give feedback on the design?
Najbardziej pomocny feedback opisuje pro: The most helpful feedback describes the problem, not just a proposed solution. Instead of “move the letter to the right”, it's better to say: “the monogram isn't very legible for us and we'd like the initials to be recognized faster”.

A situation in which one person approves the design, a second asks to go back to the previous version two days later and a third proposes a new direction prolongs the process and can lead to work beyond the original scope.

Dlaczego zestaw plików wpływa na wartość: Why does the set of files affect the value of the project?
Finalne logo powinno być możliwe do wyko: The final logo should be usable without constantly going back to the designer for another version. It also matters whether the company receives a horizontal and vertical variant, a monochrome version, a negative, files for light and dark backgrounds and formats suited to different media.
Uporządkowany zestaw plików skraca późni: An organized set of files shortens later work with the print shop, web developer, social media person or producer of promotional materials. It also reduces the risk that the logo will be accidentally stretched, saved in poor quality or used in the wrong color.
Dlatego przy porównywaniu ceny projektu: That's why when comparing the price of a design, it's worth checking not only “whether I get a logo”, but also in which variants and formats it will be delivered and whether the package gives the company sufficient documentation to apply the mark on its own.
SVG jest formatem wektorowym bardzo przy: SVG is a vector format that's very useful on the web. It can be scaled without loss of quality, so it works well on the website, in interfaces, presentations and many digital materials.
Dobrze przygotowane SVG jest szczególnie: A well-prepared SVG is especially important when the logo is to be displayed both as a small mark and as a large element of the page.
PDF może być wykorzystywany do przekazyw: PDF can be used to deliver a vector version for print and to present materials in a predictable layout. In practice, print shops often ask for a PDF prepared according to a specific specification.
Nie każdy PDF jest jednak automatycznie: However, not every PDF is automatically a “print-ready file”. What matters includes how the colors are prepared, how elements are embedded and the requirements of the specific production.
AI jest natywnym formatem Adobe Illustra: AI is Adobe Illustrator's native format and can serve as an editable source file. EPS is also a vector format used in various production processes.
Dostęp do pliku źródłowego ma znaczenie: Access to the source file matters when the design will in future be adapted by another designer, a print shop or the company's internal team. However, you need to check whether source files are part of a given package — scopes may differ.
PNG jest wygodny do codziennego użycia c: PNG is convenient for everyday digital use, especially when a transparent background is needed. JPG works well for simple applications where transparency isn't needed.
Nie powinny one jednak zastępować plików: However, they shouldn't replace vector files when the logo is to be printed in a large format or professionally edited further.

styl zdjęć i grafik,: the style of photos and graphics,
